 ACES Head To Bay Oval After Winning Ford Trophy Opener
 Friday, 30 October 2026, 1:12 pm 
 Press Release: Auckland Cricket 
 30 October, 2026
 Photo
credit: Photosport The Auckland ACES
travel to Bay Oval to face Northern Districts on Saturday 31
October, following a winning start to their Ford Trophy
campaign against Canterbury.
 Centuries from Dale
Phillips and captain Sean Solia led the way at Eden Park’s
Kennards Hire Community Oval on Wednesday 28
October.
 Phillips struck 112 from just 95 balls,
including 11 fours and six sixes. Solia scored 120 from 119
deliveries, hitting 14 fours and three sixes as both openers
reached three figures.
 Cam Fletcher added 58 from 43
balls, while Ryan Harrison provided a late burst with an
unbeaten 26 from 11.
 The ACES then bowled Canterbury
out for 311 in 44.1 overs. Angus Olliver and Adi Ashok
claimed three wickets apiece, while Solia completed a strong
all-round performance with 2/50.
 Northern Districts
also come into Saturday’s match off a high-scoring win
over Central Districts. With both sides finding form with
the bat in the opening round, an intriguing contest awaits
at Bay Oval as Auckland look to make it two wins from
two.
 Match details:
 Northern Districts vs
Auckland ACES
Ford Trophy | Round 2
Saturday 31
October 2026
10:30am start
Bay Oval, Mount
Maunganui
 Free entry 
 ACES
unavailable due to injury: Jordan Sussex, Harjot Johal,
Rohit Kumar, Samrath Singh, Ben Lister, Mark
Chapman.
